CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atlas_archive_soft_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.deleted_at is null and new.deleted_at is not null then
    insert into public.deleted_records(organization_id,clinic_id,source_table,source_id,snapshot,deleted_by,deleted_at,reason)
    values(
      new.organization_id,
      case when to_jsonb(new) ? 'clinic_id' then nullif(to_jsonb(new)->>'clinic_id','')::uuid else null end,
      tg_table_name,new.id,to_jsonb(old),auth.uid(),new.deleted_at,
      coalesce(nullif(to_jsonb(new)->>'delete_reason',''),'Eliminación desde ATLAS')
    );
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER patients_archive_soft_delete BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON public.patients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION atlas_archive_soft_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER patients_atlas_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.patients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION atlas_audit_change()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin new.updated_at = now(); return new; end $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER patients_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.patients FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_permission(target_org uuid, permission_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.organization_id=target_org and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active
      and (m.role in ('owner','administrator') or coalesce((m.permissions->>permission_name)::boolean,false))
  )
$function$
